name: Aoi Ren
source:
She is the woman of the main character's dreams. He falls in love with her at the start of his life at the academy.

She is quite out of touch with the world. She gives off the impression that she is "premium" for men.
　
She has unusual secrets that she can't tell others.

[From [url=http://www.teck.co.jp/gj/products/akiba/charashokai/tamae.htm]official site[/url]]
